output.narrative: 分享故事时，孩子需要老师给予提示，在这样的支持下参与讲述。
During small-group time, the child confidently shares a story in Chinese with the group. This gives us a picture of the child's confident participation in this storytelling setting.
这个学期，孩子表达的内容和分享的对象都有所扩展。学期初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字；到了三月，能向两位朋友讲述周末发生的事。六月的全班分享中，开始讲述时需要老师提醒，孩子能在全班面前分享一段故事。从说出自己的名字，到向朋友讲述生活中的事情，再到面向全班讲故事，这些经历呈现了孩子参与口语分享的变化。

Earlier in the semester, the child told a short story to the class without a prompt. In the last two whole-class sharing sessions in June, the child needed prompting to begin and stopped after one sentence. These recent sessions show that beginning and sustaining a whole-class contribution currently involves more support than in the earlier storytelling occasion.
这一年，孩子的口语分享从说出自己的名字，扩展到向朋友和全班讲述。年初，孩子在老师提示下说出自己的名字；四月，能用短句向两位朋友讲述周末的事情。到了十二月，孩子能自信地在全班面前讲述一段故事。不同阶段的分享让我们看到，孩子表达的内容更丰富了，分享的对象也从两位朋友扩展到了全班，并在最近的故事讲述中展现出自信。

In shared block play with two classmates, the child initially needed the teacher to model a request, then used a suggested phrase after a verbal reminder. In one May activity, the child requested a block without prompting and participated energetically, carrying blocks and suggesting bridge ideas. In the last three activities, the child contributed construction ideas and asked for a turn after a teacher reminder; no unprompted requests were recorded in those sessions. Reminders to wait until a peer has finished speaking remain part of the support the child needs during this shared play.
在口语表达活动中，孩子能在提示下说出自己的名字。面向全班讲故事时，孩子在开始讲述时需要提示，随后向全班讲述故事。这些观察呈现了孩子在不同表达任务中的参与，以及开始讲述时所需要的支持。

With picture prompts to support the telling, the child shares a short story with classmates. This offers a snapshot of the child's participation in storytelling with peers, with the pictures forming part of the support for the account.

The child's spoken contributions have expanded from one- or two-word answers to longer accounts. Earlier picture discussions involved direct teacher questions, followed by short descriptions of characters' actions with questions to extend them. In May, using a drawing and a reminder to begin, the child confidently shared seeing ducks and playing on the slide at the park. In the two most recent class sharing sessions, the child used a drawing and a reminder to begin to describe a personal experience in three or four sentences, and answered one peer's follow-up question with a teacher prompt.

The child's spoken contributions have expanded over the semester. In January, the child used single-word answers with prompting, and by March used short sentences to describe a picture with prompting. In April, picture prompts supported the child in telling a short story to the class. These observations show a change in the length and scope of the child's contributions, from individual answers to sharing a short story with a class audience.

During small-group number activities, the child extended numeral matching from 1–3 to 1–6 with teacher prompting. In a shop activity, the child selected a card from 1–6 and counted the matching toy fruits, with a reminder to touch each fruit once. In the last two counting activities, that reminder supported counting groups of up to eight objects. When asked which of two groups had more, the child placed objects side by side with teacher guidance to check. These experiences show an expanding counting range alongside supported work on comparing quantities.

output.narrative: With a teacher reminder to touch each counter, the child counts eight counters. The reminder is part of the support for this counting task, in which the child works with a group of eight.
这一年，孩子参与口语分享的内容和范围有所扩展。年初，孩子在老师提示下说出自己的名字；四月，能向两位熟悉的朋友讲述一件事情。七月的小组活动中，孩子借助图片提示讲述故事。到十二月底，孩子能在全班面前讲述一段故事，开始讲述时仍需要老师提醒。从说出名字到分享事情和故事，孩子有了面向不同听众表达的经历，最近也能在老师提醒开始后向全班讲述。
在向同伴提出轮流使用的请求时，孩子曾需要老师逐句提示。六月的一次积木活动中，孩子没有老师提示便向同伴提出了轮流使用的请求。这一次的表现，让我们看到孩子在这项与同伴沟通的任务中，有了自行提出请求的经历。

Over the year, the child has counted larger groups of counters with a teacher reminder to touch each counter once. A group of three in January was followed by six in April and nine in July. By late December, the child counted a group of twelve with the same reminder. This shows an expansion in the number of counters the child counts, with the teacher's reminder remaining part of the support throughout these counting experiences.
六月的观察中，孩子在不同分享情境下呈现出不同的表达情况。与两位熟悉的朋友交谈时，孩子能清楚地讲故事；在全班面前分享时，孩子需要老师逐句提示。熟悉朋友之间的讲述和全班分享，都让我们看见孩子的口语参与，也呈现了面向全班时仍需要的具体支持。

Over the semester, the child's spoken sharing has expanded in content and audience. Earlier, a teacher prompt supported the child in saying their own name. The child later told two friends about a weekend activity. By June, with a reminder to begin, the child shared a short story with the class. These observations trace a move from naming to recounting an experience and sharing a story with a larger audience, with a reminder still supporting the start of the latest class contribution.

With teacher prompting, the child has extended the range of numerals matched to groups of objects. In February, the child matched numerals 1 and 2 to groups; by June, the child matched numerals 1–6 with teacher prompting. The later observation shows the child working across a wider numeral range while continuing to receive support for the matching task.
孩子的中文表达从回答动物名称，扩展到了描述动作和讲述故事。学期初看图时，孩子在老师提问后说出动物名称，之后能在追问下用短句描述小兔子的动作。五月的一次小组活动中，借助三张图片和转折处的两次提示，孩子按顺序讲述了小兔子找朋友的故事。最近两次小组故事活动中，孩子借助图片说出开始和结尾，连接中间情节仍需要老师提问提示，也能回应一位同伴关于故事人物的简单问题。
四月的一次小组活动中，孩子能等候同伴说完后再发言。最近三次小组活动里，孩子都需要老师提醒等候同伴说完后再发言。这几次观察显示，在当前的小组交流中，等候同伴说完仍需要老师的提醒支持。
在小组分享中，孩子能在提示下向大家讲述一件事情。提示是孩子完成这次讲述所需要的支持，孩子在这样的支持下参与了小组的口语分享。
在小组活动中，孩子能自信地用中文分享故事。这一观察呈现了孩子在小组故事分享中的表达，也让我们看到孩子在这一情境下自信地参与中文讲述。
